blogs.title: What is LongRoPE and Why a 2‑Million‑Token Context Window Matters
blogs.description: An accessible overview of the LongRoPE technique, explaining the core problem of limited context windows in mainstream LLMs and how extending to 2 M tokens opens up new use‑cases—from ultra‑long document summarization to memory‑intensive chatbot interactions.

blogs.title: Unpacking the RoPE Magic: Non‑Uniform Positional Interpolation Explained
blogs.description: A deep dive into Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) and the two key non‑uniformities—frequency across dimensions and token position—that LongRoPE exploits. The post demystifies the mathematical ideas behind rescaling angles and shows why a single scaling factor fails when context grows.

blogs.title: How Evolutionary Search Turns a 4k LLM into a 2048k Powerhouse
blogs.description: This entry walks readers through the evolutionary algorithm used by LongRoPE, including its smart initialization, monotonic constraints, and mutation strategy. It explains how a handful of perplexity evaluations can discover the best rescaling pattern without millions of model runs.

blogs.title: The Progressive Path to 2 M Tokens: From 4k to 256k and Beyond
blogs.description: A step‑by‑step guide to LongRoPE’s progressive extension strategy—starting with a search for 256k, fine‑tuning for that length in just a thousand steps, then another search to leap to 2048k. The article explains why this breaks the barrier without huge compute.

blogs.title: Keeping Short Prompts Strong: How LongRoPE Recovers 4k Performance
blogs.description: Long context extensions often hurt short‑prompt ability. This post shows how an additional search phase tailors RoPE scaling back to 4–8 k lengths, ensuring the model remains competitive on typical benchmarks while still handling millions of tokens.

blogs.title: "Passkey Retrieval"—A Practical Test of Giant Context Windows
blogs.description: "Passkey retrieval" is a synthetic benchmark used in the paper. This blog explains how it works, shows the results for LongRoPE versus other baselines, and illustrates what this means for real‑world scenarios like searching for a phrase buried deep in a long PDF.
